summary: 12/12 MUST passed, 3/5 SHOULD passed (meets minimum 3), 0/3 MAY (bonus only)

M1.notes: _handle_set validates args/key/value/capacity, stores in self._data, returns OK

M2.requirement: GET <key> returns value or ERR key_not_found
M2.notes: _handle_get returns self._data[key] on hit, ERR key_not_found on miss

M3.requirement: DEL <key> removes key, ERR key_not_found if missing
M3.notes: _handle_del checks existence, deletes with del, returns OK or ERR key_not_found

M4.requirement: KEYS lists all keys, terminated by END
M4.notes: _handle_keys returns keys newline-separated, terminated by END. Empty store returns just END.

M6.notes: _handle_exists returns TRUE if key in self._data, else FALSE

M7.requirement: FLUSH removes all keys, returns OK

M8.requirement: OK for successful SET and DEL
M8.notes: Both _handle_set and _handle_del return OK on success path

M9.notes: execute() dispatches via _DISPATCH dict; missing commands return ERR unknown_command

M10.requirement: Max key length enforced, ERR key_too_long
M10.notes: _validate_key checks len(key) > MAX_KEY_LENGTH (64). Used by SET and GET.

M11.requirement: Max value size enforced, ERR value_too_large
M11.notes: _validate_value checks len(value) > MAX_VALUE_SIZE (1024). Used by SET.

M12.requirement: Max stored keys enforced, ERR store_full (except updating existing key)
M12.notes: _check_capacity returns ERR only when key is new AND len(self._data) >= MAX_KEYS (100). Updating existing key is allowed.

S1.notes: _handle_mset validates all pairs atomically before writing, returns OK {n}. Handles odd args gracefully.

S2.requirement: MGET <k1> <k2> ... returns values/NIL, terminated by END
S2.notes: _handle_mget returns value per key or NIL for missing, terminated by END marker.

S3.requirement: TTL <key> returns seconds, -1, or ERR key_not_found
S3.notes: TTL not implemented. No handler in _DISPATCH, no _expiry tracking in __init__. Would return ERR unknown_command.

S4.notes: SETEX not implemented. No handler in _DISPATCH, no expiration mechanism. Would return ERR unknown_command.

S5.notes: _handle_append concatenates to existing value with size validation, or creates new key (mirroring SET), returns OK {len}.

edge_case_notes: Empty command input returns empty string (not an error) — not covered by any spec requirement, acceptable behavior
SET preserves spaces in values via ' '.join(args[1:])
Command parsing is case-insensitive via cmd.upper()
KEYS on empty store returns just END marker — correct per spec
MGET with no args returns just END marker
_require_args validation returns ERR wrong_number_of_arguments for insufficient args — reasonable defensive extension not conflicting with spec
GET validates key length (M10) — more comprehensive than strictly required, but consistent
